questions.question: Which flattening operator should back a 'Pay now' button so rapid double-clicks send only one payment request?
questions.explanation: exhaustMap ignores new source values while the current inner Observable is still running, so extra clicks are dropped.

questions.question: A search stream uses `switchMap(t => api.search(t))` followed by an outer `catchError(() => of([]))`. What happens after one failed request?
options: The stream completes, so later searches never run
The failed request is retried automatically
Only that one result is skipped and searching continues
Angular restarts the stream on the next change detection
questions.explanation: An error reaching the outer pipe ends the stream; catchError replaces it with of([]) which then completes. Catch inside the inner Observable instead.

questions.question: What happens if you call `toSignal(obs$)` inside a click handler with no injector option?
options: It throws because toSignal needs an injection context to manage cleanup
It converts the click handler into an effect
questions.explanation: toSignal ties its subscription to the current injection context's lifetime; outside one you must pass an injector.

questions.question: What does `shareReplay({ bufferSize: 1, refCount: true })` give a config Observable consumed by ten components?
options: Ten separate HTTP requests, one per component
A request that repeats every second
One shared HTTP request, with late subscribers receiving the cached last value
questions.explanation: shareReplay multicasts a single subscription to the source and replays the buffered latest value to new subscribers.
